scope: Dynamic RNE acquired-motion fitting without local road geometry, measurement-history replay, map localization or relocalization. All preceding default, kinematic, reference and existing local/history paths retain their original sampling semantics.
model: Record chassis-to-rear-axle distance 1.5 m and instantaneous_odometry=true in pipeline metadata. Integrate adjacent synchronous measured wheel/gyro endpoints with trapezoidal rates and midpoint body displacement. Keep latest measured course speed for control. No-slip low-speed approximation; dynamic lateral slip remains unmeasured.
unchanged: all frozen world inputs and seeds

canary.fixed_inputs: Replay both original native mission sensor recordings with only rear_axle_offset_m and instantaneous_odometry changed; require exact legacy replay first. Raw acquired sensor bytes are unchanged and counterfactual commands are never applied.
canary.closed_loop: Run the original native seed-7 mission with every preceding audit and directional certificate; retain original goal failure if still present.

full_adoption: Original all-case strict/mission gate remains separate. Conditional no-slip calibration does not qualify measured uncertainty, general dynamic slip or physical safety.

preceding_version.reason: Body-reference calibration alone reduced seed-7 worst required 8 s radius by 22%, below the predeclared 50% requirement; seed 42 improved. Original goal failure retained.

failure_policy: A missing, cached or noncontiguous endpoint cannot cover an instantaneous interval; latch the existing motion discontinuity and brake. Instantaneous sampling is rejected with measurement-history or map/relocalization configuration. Missing metadata preserves legacy held-rate replay.
